post_title: What Can an Intern Do? 15 Real Tasks to Give Them

captions.linkedin:
What can an intern actually do? 15 real tasks, team by team.

Marketing: social posts, competitor research, a monthly report
Sales: lead lists, CRM clean-up, call prep
Operations: map a process, update templates, organise folders
Data: a customer survey, spreadsheet clean-up, a one-page summary
Projects: plan an event, test a tool, pitch an idea

Real work makes better interns, and better hires.
